name: Face Detection Benchmarking Framework
description: A framework and guidelines for constructing face detection benchmark databases to evaluate detector performance across standardized conditions.
typical_sota_score: varies by dataset; often 90–99% on controlled/easy subsets
reputation: A well-cited guideline paper that has influenced how face detection benchmarks are constructed, but it is a methodology paper rather than a single standard dataset.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; applicability depends on dataset curation; susceptible to dataset bias (pose, occlusion, demographics) and ethical/privacy concerns; results can saturate on easy subsets.
